source_text.ISS-0936: Issue ISS-0936 (local record docs/issues/ISS-0936.yaml, queue_ref Q-919, queue task 919, GH#2070; record may not yet be on this branch - PR #2071): scripts/uat_preflight.sh's qa-uat-env credential protocol (fetch_credential, ~line 290) expects the credential source's `token <user>` to print a line `Token: <jwt>`, but ai-dala-infra's qa-uat-env.sh `token <user>` prints a BARE JWT, so every actor login reports NO_PASSWORD. Fix: make fetch_credential accept a bare JWT line (three dot-separated base64url segments) as well as the `Token:` form. Add/adjust tests per project's existing preflight tests (none found under test/ -- TEST-DESIGNER decides a minimal in-repo test shape). Also update the script's header docs (qa-uat-env protocol paragraph) and scripts/README.md if they state the Token: form.

task.description: WF-03 Step 3 implement per validated design lib/letflow/design/iss0936-uat-preflight-bare-jwt.md: change ONLY scripts/uat_preflight.sh (new pure helper parse_token_line in the embedded Python, fetch_credential qa-uat-env branch calls it per line, header docs paragraph updated to say both `Token: <jwt>` and a bare JWT line are accepted). Do NOT write the ExUnit test (TEST-DESIGNER's Step 4 does). Never echo tokens. Keep qa-login branch unchanged. Verify by running the script yourself with a fake credential source (tmp files outside the repo; set --idp-url equal to --base-url e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9 to stay hermetic; on this host the default bash is a WSL stub, use Git Bash e.g. C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe): bare JWT -> not NO_PASSWORD; Token: form -> still parsed; noise-only -> NO_PASSWORD; hostname-only line -> NO_PASSWORD. Quote actual outputs. Work only in context.worktree; do not commit; do not push.

result.summary: Added pure parse_token_line (R1-R4) above fetch_credential in scripts/uat_preflight.sh; qa-uat-env branch calls it per stdout line; qa-login untouched; header protocol paragraph updated (Token: or bare JWT, ISS-0936); scripts/README.md has no Token: hit. Real runs via Git Bash, hermetic (idp=base=http://127.0.0.1:9): bare JWT after WARN line -> BAD_CRED (not NO_PASSWORD); Token: form -> BAD_CRED; CRLF bare -> BAD_CRED; noise-only -> NO_PASSWORD; auth.qa.bizdala.com / qa.bizdala.com -> NO_PASSWORD. JWT literal absent from --out JSON in all runs. ExUnit test not written (Step 4). No mix toolchain relevance (shell script).
